thread:
Maya: Heads up — got invoice from DataPipe with CA sales tax charged but they uploaded a CA resale certificate last week. Invoice 2026-INV-789 shows $3,420 tax on a $34,200 line. PO: 98765. PDF: https://invoices.example.com/2026-INV-789.pdf

Rob: Quick Q — is vendor billing as a marketplace seller or direct? Need vendor entity address + where services were delivered to confirm nexus.

Maya: They're DataPipe Inc (NY HQ) but submitted CA reseller permit CR-123456 via Coupa on 2026-03-15. Services are for prod infra in us-west-1 (CA region). I attached the Coupa cert screenshot.

Jessica: FYI our Stripe tax collection was not enabled for this vendor so tax flowed onto their invoice. Two options: vendor reissues net invoice or we process a credit memo. Which path is faster for AP? :thinking_face:

Tomas: For sales tax we prefer vendor reissue (clean audit trail). If vendor won't reissue, AP can issue credit memo and label it as 'sales tax credit' referencing the resale cert. Note: gross-up is a separate concept for withholding — don't conflate.

Rob: Also check whether CA BOE use-tax exposure exists. If services are consumed in CA and vendor isn't a reseller under CA rules, we might still owe. But reseller cert should cover it.

Maya: AP reached out to vendor: "Please reissue a net invoice referencing CA resale permit CR-123456 or we'll apply a credit memo to the next payment." Vendor replied: "We can reissue by EOD tomorrow." :thumbsup:

Jessica: For bookkeeping: when you apply the credit, include the resale cert ID and attach Coupa evidence in the AP record. Put the credit on tax line and reference original invoice number for audit.

Maya: Great. I'll monitor. If vendor misses reissue deadline, I'll ask AP to create credit memo and tag @Tomas for any compliance escalation.

invoice-bot: Event: vendor-invoice 2026-INV-789 processed (status=tax_charged)

Rob: Closing note: If reissue arrives, file original invoice annotated and update payment schedule. If not, proceed with credit memo then reconcile in next month close. Thanks everyone.
